description: Estimate embedded emissions (tCO2e) and EU CBAM certificate cost for steel exported to the EU. Input a production route (industry-average intensity, worldsteel 2023) or a carbon intensity such as an EPD A1–A3 value. The certificate cost is calculated only when an EU ETS price is given; no carbon price is assumed. Rough estimate: the free-allocation phase-out and carbon prices paid in the country of origin are not deducted. 估算鋼材出口歐盟的內含碳排與 CBAM 憑證成本；未提供 EU ETS 碳價時只算碳排量。

carbon_intensity.description: Carbon intensity in tCO2e per tonne (e.g. from an EPD); overrides route / 碳強度

eu_ets_price_eur.description: Optional EU ETS price in EUR per tCO2e / 選填，EU ETS 碳價

route.description: Production route: blast furnace–BOF, electric arc furnace, DRI–EAF / 製程

weight_tons.description: Steel weight in tonnes / 鋼材重量（公噸）
